name: Restoque Comercio e Confeccoes de Roupas S.A.
summary: Restoque Comércio e Confecções de Roupas S.A. designs and retails fashion apparel and accessories primarily for women and men in Brazil. Its products include daily wear, formal attire, shirts and blouses, jeans products and T-shirts, footwear, dresses, casuals, formals, fragrances, and shoes, as well as home décor, cosmetics, and make-up products for children. The company sells its products through its stores, online sales, and multi-brand stores. As of March 31, 2018, it owned and operated 283 stores under the Le Lis Blanc Deux, Dudalina, Bo.Bô, John John, Noir Lelis, Individual, and Rosa Chá; and operated 1 multi-brand store, 29 outlets, and 15 franchises, as well as 2 distribution centers in the states of São Paulo and Goiás. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
